description: Art explores what art is and why it matters, the elements and principles of design, creating work in several media, a design project, visiting an art venue, and careers in art.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: What art is
requirements.summary: What art is, why it matters to people and what it means to you.

requirements.title: Elements of art
requirements.summary: Line, value, shape, form, space, color and texture, with examples.

requirements.title: Principles of design
requirements.summary: The principles of design such as rhythm, balance, proportion and unity.

requirements.title: Working in several media
requirements.summary: Rendering a subject in several different media.

requirements.title: A design project
requirements.summary: One option: designing something useful, telling a story in pictures, or designing a logo.

requirements.title: Visiting an art venue
requirements.summary: Visiting a museum, gallery, exhibit or artist’s workshop and discussing what you learned.

requirements.title: Art careers
requirements.summary: Art career options and the preparation one of them requires.
